title: Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Built-In Transportation Expense Schedule
content:
Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage includes a built-in transportation expense benefit. Its figures are the same on all six deductible options.

| Deductible option | Benefit per day (USD) | Maximum per loss (USD) | Waiting period after a total theft is reported | Waiting period after any other covered loss |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Physical Damage $2,000 Deductible | 20.00 | 600.00 | 48 hours | 24 hours |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible | 20.00 | 600.00 | 48 hours | 24 hours |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $750 Deductible | 20.00 | 600.00 | 48 hours | 24 hours |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $500 Deductible | 20.00 | 600.00 | 48 hours | 24 hours |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $250 Deductible | 20.00 | 600.00 | 48 hours | 24 hours |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $100 Deductible | 20.00 | 600.00 | 48 hours | 24 hours |

## Points of reading

- The per-day figure is the benefit for each day of documented rental or transportation cost; the maximum is the most paid for one loss.
- The waiting period is 48 hours after a total theft is reported and 24 hours after any other covered loss.
- *Hypothetical:* at 20.00 per day, the per-loss maximum of 600.00 corresponds to 30 days of benefit.
